cohort: 145 fatal PTE cases from the School of Forensic Medicine, China Medical University in Liaoning Province, northeast of China
finding: The study found that 92.9% of PTE occurred within 60 days of exposure to a major risk factor, with the top five risk factors being immobilization, trauma, surgery, cesarean section, and mental disorders.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was found to be one of the top five risk factors for PTE.
